package.description: Open-source robot simulator for modeling, programming, and simulating robots, vehicles, and mechanical systems.

en-US.author: Cyberbotics, Ltd.
en-US.description: Open-source robot simulator for modeling, programming, and simulating robots, vehicles, and mechanical systems.
en-US.longDescription:
Webots provides a complete development environment to model, program, and simulate robots, vehicles, and mechanical systems. It is a beginner friendly software that is meant to introduce newcomers to the world of robotics.
Webots offers a large collection of professionally developed robot models, sensors, actuators, and objects that can be shared through the community. It includes a physics engine, a set of cross-platform development tools with a graphical interface, and native support for programming robots in C, C++, Python, ROS, ROS 2, and other interfaces. Simulations run on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and scenes are described in VRML-based world files (.wbt) that can be edited in the built-in scene editor.
en-US.name: Webots
en-US.releaseNotes:
Some new robot model, new demos, improved ROS 2 support, and many other improvements.

It is recommended to proceed with this update.

See the official announcement and the complete change log for details.

zh-CN.description: 开源机器人仿真器，用于对机器人、车辆和机械系统进行建模、编程和仿真。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Webots 提供了一套完整的开发环境，用于对机器人、车辆和机械系统进行建模、编程和仿真。它是一款对新手友好的软件，旨在引导初学者走进机器人学的世界。
Webots 提供大量专业制作的机器人模型、传感器、执行器和可共享的物体资源。它内置物理引擎、一套带图形界面的跨平台开发工具，并原生支持使用 C、C++、Python、ROS、ROS 2 等接口为机器人编程。仿真可在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行，场景以基于 VRML 的世界文件（.wbt）描述，可在内置场景编辑器中编辑。
